summary: Generates synchronized dialogue, sound effects, and music. Output is always mono. Every Seedance video Lixpi produces has audio because nothing ever sets this to false.
combines: Dialogue placed in double quotes inside the prompt improves the generated speech.
2.5 additionally accepts audio-only input; the 2.0 series requires at least one reference image or video.

usage.from: state.videoGenerationConfig.generateAudio, which no matrix control ever sets
usage.what: Decides whether the clip carries generated dialogue, effects, and music. The !== 'false' test means the absent value reads as true, so every Seedance video Lixpi produces has audio. Also read at :192 to record hasAudio on the asset.
